The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6c7151f9581ddd5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. statement: Let X be a connected compact Kähler manifold whose holomorphic tangent bundle is nef in the analytic sense. Suppose 0 ≤ d = dimC X − ̃ q(X) ≤ 6. Then there is a connected finite étale cover X′ → X with the following properties. 1. The Albanese map α : X′ → A = Alb(X′) is a smooth proper surjection with connected fibres, where A is a complex torus of dimension ̃ q(X). Every fibre is rational homogeneous of dimension d, with a point allowed when d = 0. 2. There is one such fibre F for which α is a holomorphically locally trivial F-bundle. The ordinary universal cover of X is biholomorphic to ̃ X ≃ F × C̃ q(X) . It is therefore biholomorphic to a quasi-projective variety and is holomorphically convex. Its Remmert reduction is the projection F × C̃ q(X) −→ C̃ q(X) . In particular, these conclusions hold whenever dimC X ≤ 6.
